=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:150-178 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The helper makes one `gh api` REST call per advancing commit during identity verification.
  WHY: This is the same per-item API pattern all reviewers identified; it increases API usage and conflicts with the repository’s batched GraphQL preference, with reviewers disagreeing only on operational severity.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:55-61 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback path for deriving the repository from `git remote get-url origin` only matches `github.com[:/]` remotes.
  WHY: This is a fail-open limitation for non-standard or enterprise GitHub remotes; only one reviewer reported it, and no stronger severity was stated.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1537-1544 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-editor stale-base gate is conditioned on `env.CAN_PUSH == 'true'`.
  WHY: Both reviewers flagged the same gating mismatch; it can skip stale-base detection entirely when push permission is unavailable, though one reviewer noted the current flow makes this mostly moot.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1788-2813 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Workflow comments and references point at outdated line numbers and section references.
  WHY: This is a documentation/reference correctness issue only reported by one reviewer, with no runtime failure asserted.
- README.md:65-69 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: README links to stale `agents.md` section references.
  WHY: The cited sections were renumbered elsewhere in the same change, so the README references now point to the wrong documentation sections.
- agents.md:640 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The “Failure-Comment Attribution” section still references `§20.3` in its judge-at-cap note.
  WHY: This is an internal cross-reference mismatch within the documentation and was only reported by one reviewer.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:77-81 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Missing required env vars cause the helper to exit `0` with `ADVANCE=unknown`.
  WHY: This is framed as a documentation/convention mismatch rather than a runtime failure, and only one reviewer reported it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:175-183 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper makes one `gh api` REST call per advancing commit during identity verification.
  WHY: In the worst case this creates O(N) API calls instead of a batched lookup, which the review treats as a GitHub API hygiene violation.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:91-92 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The repository-detection pattern `*github.com[:/]*` is unconventional and may be misinterpreted.
  WHY: The pattern could fail for non-standard GitHub URLs or future interpretation changes, making the fallback harder to maintain.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1544 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The pre-editor gate only runs when `CAN_PUSH == 'true'`.
  WHY: This can waste editor compute on stale-base cases when the workflow cannot push, though the reviewer considered it a low-confidence limitation.
